gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-pridi: Pridi, a refined text serif, leaves generous gaps where its curves meet the stem, and its small letters stand almost capital-sized. Capture It, sealed-up and sturdy, has no swell in its curves at all.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-scope-one: Tall, tight, nearly sealed: Capture It hits hard up top. Scope One does the opposite job well, letting its counters spill out beneath its stubby ascenders and descenders.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px is bookish and dignified, with generous openings in its rounded letters. What stands out most is the tension, since Capture It keeps its letters nearly sealed while the body lets every shape breathe.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-suwannaphum: Capture It stacks a towering x-height with nearly sealed letters, built from strokes that never swell or thin. Suwannaphum does the opening up, its c as open as a bent paperclip.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-domine: Raw and tactical up top, with big-bodied lowercase in Capture Smallz. Domine is the pair's best trick, tapering its strokes like glass rods around a breathing space inside every curve.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-esteban: Refined best describes Esteban, whose thin strokes are only slightly slimmer than its stems. And what holds the pair is the gap between that moderate contrast and Capture Smallz, raw and big-bodied with low contrast.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-faustina: Blunt up top, graceful below, with Capture Smallz raw and big-bodied. But Faustina does the finer work, thinning its bowls gently and opening its c like a pair of pliers.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-halant: Capture Smallz hits with raw, big-bodied lowercase and barely any thick-thin shift. And Halant does the quieter work, its terminals pointing outward like tongs around a faint but real contrast.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-headland-on: Dignified and traditional, Headland One spaces its letters well apart and keeps its stroke variation gentle. And beneath Capture Smallz, a modest body size would let that worn-stamp restraint show.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-hedvig-lett: Hedvig Letters Serif is authoritative, with open-ended curves that breathe. Paragraph after paragraph would move steadily, its sturdy lowercase and modest contrast like lightly engraved brass, with Capture Smallz hitting harder above.
